description: Common English labels for data work template pages.

labels.savedBuiltinExecutableHint: The built-in API and parameters saved with this job are selected. Register the API in M90002 to reuse it for new jobs; registration does not replace this job's settings.
labels.webApiExecutableHint: Python API defaults come from M90002. This screen shows the selected job's saved parameters.
labels.omlExecutableHint: OML4Py resource defaults come from M90002. This screen shows the selected job's saved parameters.
labels.paramDescMaxSymbolicTerms: Maximum retained polynomial Symbolic Regression term count
labels.paramDescSimpleArithmeticFirstYn: Try coefficient-free arithmetic rules before fitted regression (Y/N)
labels.paramDescSimpleArithmeticMinMatchRate: Minimum dominant-row match rate for a coefficient-free arithmetic rule
labels.paramDescSimpleArithmeticMaxTerms: Maximum source term count for coefficient-free arithmetic candidates (2-4)
labels.paramDescSimpleArithmeticTolerancePct: Relative match tolerance for arithmetic discovery; 0.01 means 1%
labels.paramDescDimensionReductionMode: Feature reduction: AUTO, PCA, or NONE. PCA keeps representative source columns and never stores synthetic PC columns.
labels.paramDescEstimationMode: Linear estimator: AUTO, OLS, or ROBUST_IRLS. AUTO selects robust iteration only after outlier and validation checks.
labels.paramDescMonteCarloMode: Stability validation: OFF, AUTO, BOOTSTRAP, or REPEATED_HOLDOUT. Final correction values are never randomized.
labels.paramDescMonteCarloMaxRows: Maximum rows used only for stability validation (100-10000)
labels.paramDescBanffMode: Single-ratio candidate: AUTO, RATIO, or OFF. This is a limited Banff-inspired feature, not full Banff.

messages.webApiHelpHtml:
Web API generates a saved API call specification. INTERNAL_API invokes a same-server Python function; EXTERNAL_API uses the registered HTTP contract.

  • Unified Editing: UNIFIED_EDITING_PROFILE/RELATION/DISCOVER/DETECT run the four stages, each with existing Oracle analysis followed by mixed Python analysis. Mixed options are separate from existing-analysis options.
  • Saved and imported jobs: An allowed built-in job can restore its API contract without a central registry ID. Import creates a new draft with the source contract; review the target and parameters, generate the API spec, then save before execution.
  • Integrated Relation Matrix & Network Cluster: Produces categorical, continuous, and mixed relationship pairs, keeps passed/below-threshold status, and derives network edges, nodes, and clusters.
  • Integrated Rule Discover: Runs categorical Apriori and continuous LASSO/Symbolic work according to P_RULE_PARTS. Cluster usage is controlled by P_CLUSTER_USAGE_MODE.
  • Integrated Rule Violation Detect: Runs categorical and continuous violation tasks. With P_CONTINUE_ON_ERROR=Y, review the partial-completion message for failed subtasks.
  • Individual APIs: LASSO Feature Select, Relation Network Cluster, and Symbolic Regression Rule remain available for focused jobs.
  • Runtime values: Preset JSON initializes a job; results are explained from saved job parameters and actual run values.
